messages:
anika: Heads-up — Olive9b (int4) canary started throwing OOMs under steady load. Reproducer in CI points to prefix-heavy chat patterns.

jamie: Paste the tail of the error?

anika: ```
2026-03-20T14:02:21Z ERROR inference: alloc failed: out of memory
... runtime: alloc failed while prefetching KV pages
KV cache size jumped ~3x when max_new_tokens=512 + prefetch=256
```

infra-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deploy failed for olive9b-int4-v1 on pool-gpu-a. Auto-rollback.

sasha: Hypothesis: fragmentation + aggressive prefetch + high default max_new_tokens. Int4 model weights small but KV/transient buffers still spike.

liam: Local repro quick numbers (60s soak):
- defaults: 420 qps, p95 78ms, OOMs ~2/hr
- tuned (prefetch=64, max_new_tokens=128): 385 qps, p95 85ms, OOMs 0
Tradeoff ~8-9% throughput for stability.

anika: Immediate mitigations: prefetch=64, max_new_tokens_default=128, enable warmstart compaction, soft-kv-trim at 0.8.

jamie: Config snippet for canary?

sasha: ```
model: olive9b-int4-v1
serve_preset:
  prefetch_pages: 64
  max_new_tokens_default: 128
  warmstart_compact: true
  kv_trim_threshold: 0.8
  batch: {max_batch_tokens: 4096, min_batch_size: 2}
```
Keep max_batch_tokens to avoid tiny microbatches under chat.

anika: Added 30-request warmup to run compaction after warmstart to reduce cold->warm fragmentation.

liam: With override + warmup: steady qps 370, p95 90ms, mem headroom +14%, OOMs 0. No eval quality regressions on our internal QA set.

bench-bot: Canary bench: https://bench.redwood/olive9b/1752467890 . Summary: p95 +5ms, throughput -11%, mem-95th -18%.

jamie: OK as temporary default. Longer-term: kernel allocator improvements, workload-aware prefetch, per-route max_new_tokens in Console.

sasha: Action items: 1) anika push canary override, 2) jamie monitor OOM/latency for 24h, 3) liam schedule kernel/alloc investigation with eng-infra.

anika: Pushed canary config and filed INF-5421 for kernel/alloc follow-up.

infra-bot: Ticket INF-5421 created — "olive9b int4 transient allocs / kernel sched / prefetch heuristics". Assigned liam, eng-infra.

jamie: Adding dashboard card & alert (OOMs >3 per hour).

anika: Will keep canary live 24h and report. :thumbsup:

sasha: If stable, promote override into staging defaults and add dev-notes about throughput vs stability tradeoff.

liam: Note: for short chats we can raise max_batch_tokens (e.g., 6144) to recover ~4% qps without increasing prefetch. Follow-up experiment.

anika: Closing thread for now, will reopen if OOMs reappear. :white_check_mark:
